command_line:
set -eu
{
  printf '%s\n' '---root---'; ls -la /
  printf '%s\n' '---matches---'; find / -type f \( -name 'atac.wdl' -o -name 'caper' -o -name 'caper.py' -o -name 'cromwell*.jar' -o -name 'atac-seq-pipeline.py' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100
  printf '%s\n' '---commands---'; for x in bash java cromwell caper singularity docker wget curl; do command -v "$x" || true; done
  printf '%s\n' '---directories---'; find / -maxdepth 3 -type d \( -name '*atac*' -o -name '*caper*' -o -name '*pipeline*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100
} > runtime_probe.txt
